table_rows: Support of  intra-frequency DAPS-HO  Support of simultaneous DL reception of PDCCH and PDSCH from source and target cell in DAPS-HO Support of PDCCH blind decoding capability in the first MCG and second MCG.Support of cancelling UL transmission to the source cell for intra-frequency DAPS-HO
The network cannot configure UE with intra-frequency DAPS HO

Support of  inter-frequency DAPS-HO  1) Support of simultaneous DL reception of PDCCH and PDSCH from source and target cell in DAPS-HO 2) Support of PDCCH blind decoding capability in the first MCG and second MCG.
The network cannot configure UE with inter-frequency DAPS HO
Semi-static UL power sharing mode 1 for DAPS HO
Support of semi-static power sharing mode1 between source and target cells of same FR for inter-frequency DAPS HO
UE is not expected to simultaneously transmit PRACH/PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS to source and target cell that overlap in time domain
Semi-static UL power sharing mode 2 for DAPS HO
Support of semi-static power sharing mode 2 between source and target cells of same FR for inter-frequency DAPS HO
only applicable to DAPS HO in synchronous scenarios
Dynamic UL power sharing for DAPS HO
Support of dynamic power sharing between source and target cells of same FR for inter-frequency DAPS HO1)           T_offset
Indicates support of cancelling UL transmission to the source cell for inter-frequency DAPS-HO
UE does not support scheduling of overlapping PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS transmissions to source and target cells for inter-frequency DAPS-HO
